decisions.decision: Split out the sign-in as its own small input task owned by Adi, and give T-149 to Claude. Claude builds everything around the sign-in now: (1) Add a check script, tasks/check_codex.sh. It runs `codex exec --skip-git-repo-check "Reply with exactly: CODEX_OK"` and passes only if the output contains CODEX_OK and no 401. Don't trust `codex login status`, which has given false answers before. (2) Have the orchestrator or launchd run that check every hour. When it passes, the critic switches back to Codex. Claude then runs one critic pass and records the Codex verdict, which closes T-149. (3) Until then, the critic uses the Fable 5 fallback from .loop/CRITIC_POLICY.md and labels every review 'single-vendor fallback'. It never quietly runs Claude reviewing Claude. Claude must never open the Codex or OpenAI sign-in pages.
decisions.why: Only Adi can do this. It needs his OpenAI/ChatGPT account login (2026-10-08 log: 'Not logged in'; onboarding-centre-v3: never open Codex sign-in). The 2026-07-31 APPWIRE handoff shows `login status` can give a false pass, so the check uses `codex exec`.
